title: Alone
physical_identity: Narrator Allen Grady's ordinary suburban house with basement, whose doors and windows loop back inside; sky is always early morning.
scale_topology: Single finite house (bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchen, basement); exits loop back.
anomalies: Front door and broken window lead back into the house
Random food pile appears in basement
Mail slot items never appear on other side
lighting_sound: Constant early-morning daylight at windows; clock works; TV and Wi-Fi work; no other sound stated.
entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: faceless visitors (testimony, harmless)

entrances.quote: I remember my entire house falling, if that makes any sense.

entrances.method: Door of small house where note was found
entrances.conditions: locked on one side; M.E.G. breached
entrances.quote: found in front of the red-painted wooden door of a small house

exits.method: Red wooden door breached by M.E.G.
exits.quote: It is unknown why the door was locked on one side but not the other.
rescued and brought back to Base Alpha in Level 0
it just led back to my house

signature_mechanic: Self-contained house where every door or window loops back; random basement food restock; faceless visitors; notes through mail slot vanish.
verticality: House floors and a basement only.
conflicts_notes: Whole level description is one narrator's letter. Note says no way out; later M.E.G. edit says he can leave at will. Level 52/54 are nav links only.

key_quotes.quote: I tried opening my front door, but it… just led back to my house.
